description: This test case ensures users can access Roost's documentation via the footer link.
steps: Locate the 'Documentation' link in the footer using the stable selector.
Ensure the documentation page content is loaded successfully.
expected_results: User is redirected to the 'https://docs.roost.ai' page.
Documentation content is visible and accessible.
edge_cases: The documentation page fails to load due to a server issue.
User clicks the link but is redirected to an incorrect URL.
Unexpected page layout on the documentation site.
data_requirements: Valid documentation link configured in the footer.
Test environment allowing access to external documentation.
dependencies: Footer links must be configured correctly.
User must have access to external URLs.
performance_metrics: Loading time for the documentation page.
Navigation speed from the Roost site to the documentation site.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the 'Documentation' link is accessible via keyboard navigation.
Verify screen reader announces the purpose of the 'Documentation' link.
Ensure adequate color contrast for the footer link.
